notes.title: Game play guide
notes.notes:
Scoring mode: Players shoot 12 targets and strive for the highest score.
Timing Mode: Shoot 15 tough targets (need to shoot the head), the shorter the time, the better the score.
PVP: Play against other players, 3 wins out of 5 games is the final winner..
